title: Bharata proceeds to see Bharadwaja
introduction: Bharata along with Vasishta proceed to see Bharadwaja. Bharadwaja welcomes both of them hospitable. After exchanging pleasantries Bharadwaja asks Bharata whether he is coming to the forest to do any harm to Rama and Lakshmana. Bharata replies that he is coming to the forest for the purpose of taking back Rama to Ayodhya. When enquired by Bharata about the whereabouts of Rama, Bharadwaja informs that Rama along with Seetha and Lakshmana are staying on the chitrakuta mountain. Thereafter, at the request of Bharadwaja, Bharata along with his routine decides to make a night halt on that day at that hermitage and to proceed to Chitrakuta on the following morning.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवतितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 90th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
द्भरद्वाज आश्रमम् दृष्ट्वा क्रोशाद् एव नर ऋषभः |
बलम् सर्वम् अवस्थाप्य जगाम सह मन्त्रिभिः
पद्भ्याम् एव हि धर्मज्नो न्यस्त शस्त्र परिग्च्छदः |
वसानो वाससी क्षौमे पुरोधाय पुरोहितम्
verses.iast:
dbharadvāja āśramam dṛṣṭvā krośād eva nara ṛṣabhaḥ |
balam sarvam avasthāpya jagāma saha mantribhiḥ
padbhyām eva hi dharmajno nyasta śastra parigcchadaḥ |
vasāno vāsasī kṣaume purodhāya purohitam
verses.translation: Having seen Bharadwaja's hermitage at a couple of miles away, that excellent man Bharata, knowing what is right, leaving all his army behind, discarding his weapons and ornaments, and wearing simple silken garment, went forwards by foot, proceeded by Vasishta, his spiritual preceptor.

glosses.meaning: at a couple of miles away

verses.devanagari:
ततः संदर्शने तस्य भरद्वाजस्य राघवः |
मन्त्रिणः तान् अवस्थाप्य जगाम अनु पुरोहितम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ saṃdarśane tasya bharadvājasya rāghavaḥ |
mantriṇaḥ tān avasthāpya jagāma anu purohitam
verses.translation: Leaving his ministers behind at a visible distance to Bharadwaja, Bharata then went along with Vasishta, his spiritual preceptor.

glosses.meaning: at a visible distance to Bharadwaja

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठम् अथ दृष्ट्वा एव भरद्वाजो महा तपाः |
संचचाल आसनात् तूर्णम् शिष्यान् अर्घ्यम् इति ब्रुवन्
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭham atha dṛṣṭvā eva bharadvājo mahā tapāḥ |
saṃcacāla āsanāt tūrṇam śiṣyān arghyam iti bruvan
verses.translation: On seeing Vasishta, Bharadwaja the great ascetic rose quickly from his seat, asking his disciples to fetch water to wash the hand (of the distinguished guests) with.

glosses.meaning: to fetch water to wash the hands (of the distinguished guests) with.

verses.devanagari:
समागम्य वसिष्ठेन भरतेन अभिवादितः |
अबुध्यत महा तेजाः सुतम् दशरथस्य तम्
verses.iast:
samāgamya vasiṣṭhena bharatena abhivāditaḥ |
abudhyata mahā tejāḥ sutam daśarathasya tam
verses.translation: Having met Vasishta and greeted by Bharata, Bharadwaja of great splendour recognized him to be a son of Dasaratha.

verses.devanagari:
ताभ्याम् अर्घ्यम् च पाद्यम् च दत्त्वा पश्चात् फलानि च |
आनुपूर्व्याच् च धर्मज्नः पप्रग्च्छ कुशलम् कुले
verses.iast:
tābhyām arghyam ca pādyam ca dattvā paścāt phalāni ca |
ānupūrvyāc ca dharmajnaḥ papragccha kuśalam kule
verses.translation: Bharadwaja, knowing what is right, offering them both, in order of seniority, water to wash theri hands and feet with and fruits afterwards, made enquiries concerning the welfare of their family.

glosses.meaning: water to wash theri hands and feet with

verses.devanagari:
अयोध्यायाम् बले कोशे मित्रेषु अपि च मन्त्रिषु |
जानन् दशरथम् वृत्तम् न राजानम् उदाहरत्
verses.iast:
ayodhyāyām bale kośe mitreṣu api ca mantriṣu |
jānan daśaratham vṛttam na rājānam udāharat
verses.translation: Subsequently, Bharadwaja made enquires with both of them as to whether all were well in the city of Ayodhya, with the army, with the treasury, friends and counsellors. But knowing Dasaratha friends and counsellors. But knowing Dasaratha to be dead, he did not speak of the king.

glosses.itrans: Bharadwaja made enquires as to whether all were well) ayodhyaam
glosses.iast: Bharadvaja made enquires as to vhether all vere vell) ayodhyām
glosses.devanagari: Bहरद्वज मदे एन्qउइरेस् अस् तो व्हेथेर् अल्ल् वेरे वेल्ल्) अयोध्यां

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठो भरतः च एनम् पप्रग्च्छतुर् अनामयम् |
शरीरे अग्निषु वृक्षेषु शिष्येषु मृग पक्षिषु
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭho bharataḥ ca enam papragcchatur anāmayam |
śarīre agniṣu vṛkṣeṣu śiṣyeṣu mṛga pakṣiṣu
verses.translation: Vasishta and Bharata in return made enquires with Bharadwaja, if all were well with his body his sacred fires, his disciples, the trees, the deer and birds in the hermitage.

glosses.meaning: (if all were well) shariire = with his body

verses.devanagari:
तथा इति च प्रतिज्नाय भरद्वाजो महा तपाः |
भरतम् प्रत्युवाच इदम् राघव स्नेह बन्धनात्
verses.iast:
tathā iti ca pratijnāya bharadvājo mahā tapāḥ |
bharatam pratyuvāca idam rāghava sneha bandhanāt
verses.translation: The great ascetic Bharadwaja replied, "All is well" and spoke the following words to Bharata, bound as he was with affection to Rama.

glosses.meaning: bound as he was with affection to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
किम् इह आगमने कार्यम् तव राज्यम् प्रशासतः |
एतद् आचक्ष्व मे सर्वम् न हि मे शुध्यते मनः
verses.iast:
kim iha āgamane kāryam tava rājyam praśāsataḥ |
etad ācakṣva me sarvam na hi me śudhyate manaḥ
verses.translation: "For what reason have you, who are ruling the kingdom, come here? Tell me all this, for my mind is not getting cleared of doubts."

glosses.meaning: is not indeed not getting cleared (of all doubts)

verses.devanagari:
सुषुवे यम मित्रघ्नम् कौसल्य आनन्द वर्धनम् |
भ्रात्रा सह सभार्यो यः चिरम् प्रव्राजितो वनम्
नियुक्तः स्त्री नियुक्तेन पित्रा यो असौ महा यशाः |
वन वासी भव इति इह समाः किल चतुर्दश
कच्चिन् न तस्य अपापस्य पापम् कर्तुम् इह इग्च्छसि |
अकण्टकम् भोक्तु मना राज्यम् तस्य अनुजस्य च
verses.iast:
suṣuve yama mitraghnam kausalya ānanda vardhanam |
bhrātrā saha sabhāryo yaḥ ciram pravrājito vanam
niyuktaḥ strī niyuktena pitrā yo asau mahā yaśāḥ |
vana vāsī bhava iti iha samāḥ kila caturdaśa
kaccin na tasya apāpasya pāpam kartum iha igcchasi |
akaṇṭakam bhoktu manā rājyam tasya anujasya ca
verses.translation: "That annihilator of enemies, born of Kausalya for the increase of her happiness, he who with his brother and his wife have been exiled to the forest for a long period, that Rama who is full of glory, through the intrigues of a woman was condemned to dwell in the forest for fourteen years by his father. I hope you do not intend to do any harm to that irreproachable prince and his younger brother in order to enjoy the throne without hindrance."

glosses.meaning: for the increase of her happiness
throught the intrigues of a woman
I hope you do not intend

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तो भरद्वाजम् भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह |
पर्यश्रु नयनो दुह्खाद् वाचा संसज्जमानया
verses.iast:
evam ukto bharadvājam bharataḥ pratyuvāca ha |
paryaśru nayano duhkhād vācā saṃsajjamānayā
verses.translation: "Thus spoken to as aforesaid, Bharata with his eyes filled with tears in grief and in a faltering tone, replied to Bharadwaja as follows:

glosses.meaning: with his eyes filled with tears

verses.devanagari:
हतो अस्मि यदि माम् एवम् भगवान् अपि मन्यते |
मत्तो न दोषम् आशन्केर् न एवम् माम् अनुशाधि हि
verses.iast:
hato asmi yadi mām evam bhagavān api manyate |
matto na doṣam āśanker na evam mām anuśādhi hi
verses.translation: "If you the Blessed One, regard me like this, I am lost indeed! I cannot conceive of any harm towards Rama having proceeded from me. do not charge me thus."

verses.devanagari:
न च एतद् इष्टम् माता मे यद् अवोचन् मद् अन्तरे |
नाहम् एतेन तुष्टः च न तद् वचनम् आददे
verses.iast:
na ca etad iṣṭam mātā me yad avocan mad antare |
nāham etena tuṣṭaḥ ca na tad vacanam ādade
verses.translation: " I do not approve of what my mother has done when I was away from home. I am not pleased with her nor do I accept her word in this matter."

glosses.meaning: when I was away from home

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तु तम् नर व्याघ्रम् उपयातः प्रसादकः |
प्रतिनेतुम् अयोध्याम् च पादौ तस्य अभिवन्दितुम्
verses.iast:
aham tu tam nara vyāghram upayātaḥ prasādakaḥ |
pratinetum ayodhyām ca pādau tasya abhivanditum
verses.translation: "I, on my part, came to take back that tiger among men to Ayodhya, after prostrating myself at his feet and having propitiated him."

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् माम् एवम् गतम् मत्वा प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि |
शंस मे भगवन् रामः क्व सम्प्रति मही पतिः
verses.iast:
tvam mām evam gatam matvā prasādam kartum arhasi |
śaṃsa me bhagavan rāmaḥ kva samprati mahī patiḥ
verses.translation: "O, venerable one! Believing me to have come for the aforesaid purpose, you ought to do a favour for me. Tell me where Rama the Lord of the world is to be found now?"

glosses.meaning: to have come (for the aforesaid purpose)

verses.devanagari:
वशिष्ठादिभि ऋत्विग्भि र्याचितो भगवांस्ततः |
उवाच तम् भरद्वाजः प्रसादाद् भरतम् वचः
verses.iast:
vaśiṣṭhādibhi ṛtvigbhi ryācito bhagavāṃstataḥ |
uvāca tam bharadvājaḥ prasādād bharatam vacaḥ
verses.translation: Requested by Vasishta and other priests likewise, Bharadwaja answered Bharata in affectionate words as follows:

verses.devanagari:
त्वय्य् एतत् पुरुष व्याघ्रम् युक्तम् राघव वंशजे |
गुरु वृत्तिर् दमः चैव साधूनाम् च अनुयायिता
verses.iast:
tvayy etat puruṣa vyāghram yuktam rāghava vaṃśaje |
guru vṛttir damaḥ caiva sādhūnām ca anuyāyitā
verses.translation: "O, Bharata the tiger among men! Good manners towards teachers as well as self control and walking in the footsteps of virtuous men-these qualities are worthy of you, born as you are in the Raghu dynasty."

glosses.meaning: O Bharata the tiger among men!
who are born in the Raghu dynasty

verses.devanagari:
जाने च एतन् मनह्स्थम् ते दृढी करणम् अस्तु इति |
अपृग्च्छम् त्वाम् तव अत्यर्थम् कीर्तिम् समभिवर्धयन्
verses.iast:
jāne ca etan manahstham te dṛḍhī karaṇam astu iti |
apṛgccham tvām tava atyartham kīrtim samabhivardhayan
verses.translation: " I was aware of your purpose in your mind. But, I desired to confirm it and it is on this account that I asked you, in order to strengthen you fame immeasurably."

glosses.meaning: this (of your purpose) te manasstham = in your mind

verses.devanagari:
जाने च रामं धर्मज्ञं ससीतं सहलक्ष्मणम् |
असौ वसति ते भ्राता चित्र कूटे महा गिरौ
verses.iast:
jāne ca rāmaṃ dharmajJṇaṃ sasītaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam |
asau vasati te bhrātā citra kūṭe mahā girau
verses.translation: "I know where the virtuous Rama along with Seetha and LakSmana are to be found. Your elder brother is staying on the great mountain called Chitrakuta."

verses.devanagari:
श्वः तु गन्ता असि तम् देशम् वस अद्य सह मन्त्रिभिः |
एतम् मे कुरु सुप्राज्न कामम् काम अर्थ कोविद
verses.iast:
śvaḥ tu gantā asi tam deśam vasa adya saha mantribhiḥ |
etam me kuru suprājna kāmam kāma artha kovida
verses.translation: "You may proceed to that place tomorrow. Stay here today along with your ministers. O, man of great wisdom, who understands legitimate interest and desire! Grant me this desire."

glosses.meaning: who understands legitimate interest and desire!

verses.devanagari:
ततः तथा इत्य् एवम् उदार दर्शनः |
प्रतीत रूपो भरतो अब्रवीद् वचः |
चकार बुद्धिम् च तदा महा आश्रमे |
निशा निवासाय नर अधिप आत्मजः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tathā ity evam udāra darśanaḥ |
pratīta rūpo bharato abravīd vacaḥ |
cakāra buddhim ca tadā mahā āśrame |
niśā nivāsāya nara adhipa ātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Bharata of a broad outlook and whose reality (as an admirer of Rama) had now come to be known, answered thus: "So be it". Then, the prince made up his mind to stay for that night in the hermitage."

glosses.meaning: and whose reality (as an admirer of Rama) had now come to be known
